rows.title: HDMI Deep Colour
rows.desc: For the input on screen. Lets it take 4K HDR and high frame rates. The picture can drop out for a moment while the TV and the device agree the change, and turning it off also turns off Game Optimizer for that input.

rows.title: HDMI 1 audio format
rows.desc: What the TV asks the device on this input to send. Bitstream allows encoded audio; PCM requests decoded audio.

rows.title: HDMI 2 audio format
rows.desc: What the TV asks the device on this input to send. Bitstream allows encoded audio; PCM requests decoded audio.

rows.title: HDMI 3 audio format
rows.desc: What the TV asks the device on this input to send. Bitstream allows encoded audio; PCM requests decoded audio.

rows.title: HDMI 4 audio format
rows.desc: What the TV asks the device on this input to send. Bitstream allows encoded audio; PCM requests decoded audio.

rows.title: SIMPLINK (HDMI-CEC)
rows.desc: Lets the TV remote control devices connected over HDMI, such as a soundbar or console.

rows.title: Auto power sync
rows.desc: Switching the TV off switches connected devices off, and switching a device on switches the TV on.

rows.title: IP control
rows.desc: Lets home automation systems control the TV over the network with LG's own protocol. Off unless something needs it.
